caption: The drawing is on a beige or light tan background and contains three views of a rectangular object that appears to be a buckle, rendered in pencil. The upper portion of the drawing features a detailed front view of the buckle, which is rectangular with slightly chamfered corners. The frame has an inner border with floral or leaf motifs positioned at the midpoint of each of the four longer edges. The buckle has three bars extending horizontally across the right half of its inner section. Below this, there is a less detailed, lighter outline of the object viewed from the front, showing only the basic shape, internal bars, and mounting holes, but without decorative details. To the right of this lower outline, there is a side view of the object, depicted as a simple arc, indicating the buckle's slight curvature. In the lower left corner, the text "Walton, Kleeman" appears in small print. The entire drawing is monochromatic, presented in gray pencil lines against the paper’s tan tone.
title: Lady's Shoe Buckle
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
